authorization.basis: Explicit authorization in the user mission dated 2026-11-22 for one matrix capture per G08 source.

budget.monitoring: RSS, process count, and storage polling are soft observations; output byte caps and one-attempt ledgers are enforced procedurally.

capture_method.archive: matrices.npz (CSR arrays, u_pre, DOF maps), mode.npy, result.json, capture.json; identity and SHA-256 bound.
capture_method.candidate_reproduction: Compare new factor and solver residual with archived A/B references using recorded values; exact bitwise equality is not required.
capture_method.reduction: Apply the solver exact free-DOF index vector after full assembly; archive fixed/free indices and dof labels.
capture_method.solver_call: Existing public qf_solver.solve_model call, exactly once per scope.

model_and_sign_convention.K0_definition: Reduced tangent from assembly.assemble(zero displacement) on the exact registered free-DOF map.
model_and_sign_convention.Kg_definition: Reduced initial-stress second-Piola geometric tangent from assembly.geometric_tangent(u_pre), using the converged proportional-preload state.
model_and_sign_convention.pencil: Q(lambda) = K0 + lambda * Kg; lambda is the positive dimensionless load multiplier
model_and_sign_convention.reported_signed_critical_load: negative compression; archived factor lambda is positive
model_and_sign_convention.solver_source: LinearBucklingSolver.solve assembles K0 at zero and Kg at its converged preload displacement; diagnostic generalized problem is (K0 + lambda*Kg) phi = 0.
model_and_sign_convention.supports: UX, UY and UZ fixed at x=0

units.elastic_modulus: Source-native consistent stress units; E is stored as 1000000.0 without a unit label.
units.force: Source-native consistent force units; the reference resultant is -1.0.
units.interpretation: Keep values dimensionally consistent; do not attach SI units without external provenance.
units.length: Source-native consistent model units; the G08 builder does not label a physical unit.

spectral_claim_limit: Captured-matrix double-precision diagnostics are numerical observations only. FIRST_MODE_NOT_ESTABLISHED remains unless a separately validated error-controlled matrix inertia proof succeeds.
